name: Custom Shape 1-Layer Mirror Acrylic Stirrers
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Crafted from high-quality 1-layer mirror acrylic, offering a sleek, elegant, and eye-catching finish.
    - Made from 3mm thick acrylic, providing a lightweight yet sturdy structure for everyday party and drink decoration use.
    - Available in 2 mirror acrylic finishes:
              +) Gold Mirror Acrylic
              +) Silver Mirror Acrylic

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Available in the following size options:
              +) 2 x 6 in ~ 5.08 x 15.24 cm
              +) 2 x 8 in ~ 5.08 x 20.32 cm
    📌 Note: The product dimensions may vary slightly depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed.
     
  • Engraving Technology:
    - This product is made from 1-layer mirror acrylic and finished using precision laser cutting and engraving technology.
    - The final design can be created in 2 style options:
              +) Cut Out
              +) Engrave

 

  • Functional & Usage:
    - Functions as both a drink stirrer and a personalized decorative party accessory.
    - Designed to add a stylish and customized touch to cocktails, mocktails, juices, milkshakes, party cups, and dessert table drinks.
    - Suitable for graduations, birthdays, bridal showers, weddings, anniversaries, baby showers, and other special events.
    - The integrated stirrer stick makes it easy to place into drinks while also serving as a decorative topper.
    - Perfect for party table styling, event decoration, drink presentation, and memorable celebration accessories.
    - Can also be kept after the event as a fun personalized keepsake.

 

  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A meaningful personalized gift for graduates, friends, family members, coworkers, and loved ones.
    - Perfect for graduation parties, birthdays, weddings, anniversaries, bridal showers, and holiday celebrations.
    - Ideal for event planners, party hosts, and anyone who enjoys elegant custom drink accessories.
    - A thoughtful keepsake for preserving names, milestone years, and special event themes.
    - Great for party favors, drink décor, dessert table decoration, and celebration styling.
    - Adds a luxurious, festive, and memorable touch to every special occasion🎁

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days on average after payment, and all designs are updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1x Custom Shape 1-Layer Mirror Acrylic Stirrers

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • Tracking Country Origin is US

 

NOTE

guideLine:
Print Guidelines

 

  • Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. 
  • Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. 
  • Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

 

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

 

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
